cases.label: not-equivalent
cases.rationale: Complete, resolved profiles matching on cost, type line, power/toughness, keywords, color identity, and role, but diverging Oracle text ({G}{G} vs {C}{C} produced) -- a genuine functional difference must never surface as equivalence.
cases.source: Constructed negative fixture derived from a synthetic baseline ramp-creature profile; only Oracle text was varied to isolate this axis.

cases.label: not-equivalent
cases.rationale: Same baseline Oracle profile but assigned different structural roles (ramp vs draw) by the deck's own role classifier; Roles are part of the equivalence key, so a role disagreement must not surface as equivalence even when the Oracle profile matches.

cases.label: abstain
cases.rationale: Two working-list entries with different display strings resolve to the same underlying Oracle ID (e.g. an alias or flavor-name import); D-02 requires distinct Oracle IDs for a positive even when every other field matches, so this must never surface.
cases.source: Constructed defensive fixture; both entries pinned to one synthetic shared Oracle ID to isolate the same-OracleId guard.
